🇺🇸🇨🇦🇬🇧🇮🇪🇦🇺🇳🇿🇿🇦 1 (3)

Jeffrey Tucker, economist and founder of The Brownstone Institute and organizer behind The Great Barrington Declaration, describes in his article The Coup, the Calamity, and the Conspiracy the plan that was staged in February 2020. Everyone on our planet who can read should read this text! 

Tucker describes how eugenics, the doctrine of racial hygiene—a kind of applied social Darwinism that means only the most talented have the right to live and which originated in Anglo-Saxon countries in the 1910s—is in the process of being realized.

Tucker outlines three main motives and purposes for destroying the world as we knew it: 1) political, 2) technological, and 3) pharmaceutical. Below is a slightly abridged version of the three motives:

1. Political motives

Tucker describes how, in the years leading up to the COVID measures, the deep state in all nations underwent a severe crisis with referendums that did not go their way. The movement was called and condemned as populist, which meant that ordinary people used democratic means to express their opinions. All this happened between 2010 and 2020—it can also be dated back to decades earlier—and culminated in the lockdowns of 195 countries, which was the turning point that dealt a hammer blow to all these populist movements. 

Tucker exemplifies this with the power elite's relentless and often unfounded criticism of Brexit, Bolsonaro in Brazil, Salvini and the Italian First Movement, Marine Le Pen as leader of the National Rally in France, Viktor Orbán in Hungary who broke with Eurocentrism, Geert Wilders in the Netherlands who led the Freedom Party, Rodrigo Duterte in the Philippines with populist appeal, Andrzej Duda from Poland who promoted nationalist politics, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan from Turkey who joined anti-globalist tendencies, and finally the criticism of Donald Trump.

Tucker writes that one does not need to consider all these people "good" to realize how frightening they are to the neoliberal consensus, a term he uses to denote the permanent rule of the administrative state with the support of an established industrial elite in finance, pharmaceuticals, and other areas. 

He delves deeper into Trump, who won in 2016 despite every conceivable effort and expectation that he would lose. According to Tucker, this was a shock in a century of American history, a sure sign that the system established since before World War I to manipulate American election results had collapsed. The fear was that Trump was an outsider who could respond to voters' wishes and common sense, which the establishment could not tolerate. 

The conspiracy by the media, the financial establishment, and the administrative state was thus underway. The election was declared invalid due to Russian interference, and years of reporting and investigations began, which ultimately led to nothing. It just so happened that the American people chose the man who would disrupt a system that had been manipulated for most of their lives.

According to Tucker, when all other options had failed, the power elite played the pandemic card. The action took place from the fall of 2019 (the laboratory leak) to the spring of 2020, when Trump, surrounded on all sides and after much resistance, finally gave the green light to the lockdowns that destroyed the growing economy he had been trying to promote.

The promise was that a vaccine would be ready in time for the election, but its launch was delayed throughout the summer and fall, during which time he only hindered the presidency, but was otherwise ignored and ultimately deleted from all social media. However, nothing could stop the disaster they were trying to prevent, as Trump was subsequently re-elected.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: TROPICAL CYCLONE "PAOLO"
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Pampanga, Zambales and Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Rizal, Laguna, Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Bulacan and Metro Manila(Navotas, Malabon, Valenzuela, Caloocan, Manila) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

‘DI KUKURAP SA KORAP’ 

Hiphop United Against Corruption, a coalition of HipHop artists and artists’ collectives, holds a benefit event for the persons arrested during the September 21 anti-corruption protest in Mendiola. 

The event held at MEJO Kitchen & Bar in Quezon City on October 3 is also the official launch of the group. Hiphop United Against Corruption was formed as a response to the massive government corruption exposed in the flood control projects probe. The group states in its unity statement that HipHop is a ‘political movement that has historically fought against oppression, racism, and police and state violence against the people.’ They also denounce the statements made by state officials against HipHop groups, saying that it was them who stoked the violence that took place in Mendiola. Instead of recognizing the legitimate calls of the poor, Hiphop artists say, the government chooses to turn a blind eye. 

Hiphop United Against Corruption is calling on other HipHop artists to join their coalition and fight prevailing issues of government corruption.
